about: The order Saved Measurements shows the library in (savedMeasurementsOrder): the measurements as the library keeps them, in the order added, each by its name, the date it was made (timestamp) and its type (the short name the list shows: Generic, Acoustic, Classical, Flamenco, Plate, Brace, Comparison, or — for a file with no type); then cases of a sort (asAdded, date, name, type), a direction and a filter (a type, or null for all), each expecting the positions in the library to show, in order. Ties go by date, oldest first, then by position. Names compare case-insensitively. Type order is the type menu's, then Comparison, then —. 'duplicates' cases: the library's measurement ids in the order added, expecting the positions of the later copies of an id already seen (ids compare case-insensitively; the first copy of each stays) — same id means same content, since an edited measurement gets a new id.

cases.name: as added, oldest first: the library's order
date, oldest first; a shared date by position
date, newest first; a shared date still by position
name, A to Z, case-insensitive; no name first; a shared name by date
name, Z to A; a shared name still by date, oldest first
type, in the type menu's order, then Comparison, then —; one type by date
type, reversed; one type still by date, oldest first
a type with none: nothing shown

duplicates.name: a measurement imported twice: the later copy
three copies: all but the first
ids differing only in case are the same id
